chunks: If it pierced, it may be eaten, but if it did not pierce, it may not be eaten.
ai.seo_question: When is hunted game permissible to eat according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hunted game: if the hunting implement pierces the animal, it is permissible to eat it. If it does not pierce, then it is not permissible to eat it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If it pierced, it may be eaten, but if it did not pierce, it may not be eaten."
